Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-acc-A-reload-blocks.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. A same-chat reload (ctx.reloadCurrentChat: /persona-sync, a persona change on an untainted group, H9) runs ST's clearChat, which reassigns extension_prompts = {} (script.js:1590). Plan 02 section 3 then keeps the run (no reload, no epoch bump), but nothing re-injects our blocks, and every later rewrite of an unchanged block is deduped by stHost/extensionPrompts.ts lastWritten. The probe records the story_* blocks before the reload, after it, after an ST-shaped generation close (the re-application path, clearPrivateInjection -> updateInjection + updateSteering), and then sends a real /trigger and checks the request ST posted (GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, non-dry) for the checkpoint guidance text. It asserts the correct behaviour (guidance present), so it is RED while the defect stands.
